pred_ddx.label: Angioleiomyoma
supports: Microscopic examination showed thick bands of smooth muscle staining positive for smooth muscle antigens using immunochemistry
Selective superior mesenteric angiography showed a large hyper vascular mass near the terminal ileum in the right iliac fossa
Smooth muscle appeared to arise from the muscularis propria of the small bowel
Histopathology of the resected tumor showed a submucosal tumor compressing the mucosal lining causing ulceration
Sectional analysis of the tumour showed thick bands of muscle with vascular spongy stroma
Vascular channels ranging in size from dilated capillaries to a small and medium sized arteries and veins were present
Mass was supplied by a large feeding artery and drained via a solitary large vein into the portal venous system
No significant mitotic activity in the tumor and no evidence of tumor necrosis
